correctness.rationale: The exact truth recurrence for \(T_r=W\setminus\llbracket\alpha_r\rrbracket\) and \(U_r=\{u:R(u)\subseteq T_r\}\) is \(T_{r+1}=\operatorname{Pre}(U_r)\). Induction on \(i+j\) proves \(T_i\cap U_j=\varnothing\): any point in the intersection with positive \(i\) has a successor in \(T_j\cap U_{i-1}\), contradicting induction. A strict difference at index \(r+1\) entails at least \(r+1\) nonempty additions to each of \(T_{r+1}\) and \(U_r\), which are disjoint; therefore \(|W|\ge2r+2\). The path on \(2r+2\) vertices attains the threshold. Exact exhaustive enumeration of all labelled frames on 1 to 4 worlds, reproducible samples on 5, 6, and 9 worlds, and path checks through 80 worlds all passed using the packaged checker. The infinite proof is independent of these finite checks.

value.rationale: The motivating source supplied exact minimum sizes for only three indices and otherwise an upper witness. The new two-sided invariant proves sharp minimum distinguishing sizes at every index and a tight factor-two improvement on the generic finite-carrier iteration bound. This is a natural complete extremal classification with direct model-size implications for finite modal semantics, rather than a finite table extension or a renaming of prior constructions.
